feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 7 June 2026 10:39pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 07 June 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving complex low to the northwest of the British Isles, with an associated front crossing our area tonight.


##Wind##

South to southwest 5 or 6, occasional 7 in places at first, decreasing 4 or 5 shortly after midnight, then veering west or northwest later in the night. Decreasing 3 or 4, occasional 5, tomorrow morning, backing southwest in the afternoon, then increasing 4 or 5 later


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Rain, turning heavy at times. Becoming mainly fair from the west overnight. Scattered showers spreading from the west during Monday afternoon & evening.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor at times in the rain, becoming mostly good overnight, then occasionally moderate in showers later on Monday.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, soon increasing 5 or 6, veering west 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming mostly moderate for a while.


##Weather##

Showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate.
